description: Keyword search across 1,308 Indian nutrition guides on kabo.co.in (age-by-age nutrition, deficiencies, gut health, supplements, recipes), returning titles and URLs to cite. Use for topic questions such as 'vitamin D deficiency in vegetarians'; use lookup_food for a single food's values. Read-only; results are ranked by word overlap with the title, and an empty list means no guide matched.

limit.description: Maximum results to return, 1-25. Defaults to 8.

query.description: Search words, e.g. 'protein after 40' or 'iron absorption vegetarian'.

name: search_guides
title: Search Indian nutrition guides
